title: Science Fiesta for School Children from 7th to 12th Standard
content:
ATME College of Engineering is organizing Three-Day SciFest – Science Fiesta for School Children from 7th to 12th Standard from 18th to 20th October 2022 in association with KMT Group of Institutions- Wisdom PU College,  Kushalnagar

The project is approved by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), National Council for Science & Technology Communication Division, Government of India.

Date: 18th to 20th October 2022

Venue: KMT Group of Institutions - Wisdom PU College, Kushalnagar

Project Activities:

  • Hackathon
  • Poster Presentation
  • JAM Competition
  • Technical Project Exhibition
  • Science Quiz Competition
  • Essay Writing Competition

Winners and runners will get cash prize...!
